description: This Java class defines a custom layout called ShadowLayout that extends RelativeLayout. It paints a drop shadow behind all child views, with size and opacity controlled by a 'depth' factor that can be animated.

classes.name: ShadowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout that draws a drop shadow behind its child views, with adjustable depth.

methods.name: ShadowLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the ShadowLayout with context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes paint and bitmap resources for drawing the shadow.

methods.name: setShadowDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth of the shadow, affecting its offset and transparency.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the drawing method to render shadows behind child views.
